description: The bar chart titled “Model Evaluation on Academic and Practical Benchmarks” visually compares the performance of two language models — LLaMA-3-8B-it (blue bars) and “Ours (Iterative RLHF)” (orange bars) — across nine distinct evaluation datasets and metrics, displayed along the horizontal axis. The vertical axis represents “Score (%)”, ranging from 0 to 80 in increments of 10, with each bar’s height indicating the model’s performance on that benchmark. Across all benchmarks, the orange “Ours (Iterative RLHF)” model consistently outperforms or matches the blue LLaMA-3-8B-it model. Notably, on GSM-8K, both models score near 80%, with “Ours” slightly higher. On MMLU, HumanEval, ARC, and MBPP, “Ours” scores in the low-to-mid 60s while LLaMA-3-8B-it scores slightly lower in each case. On TruthfulQA, “Ours” scores approximately 60% compared to LLaMA-3-8B-it’s ~44%. On LC AlpacaEval2, “Ours” achieves ~32% versus LLaMA-3-8B-it’s ~24%. On MT-Bench (×5), “Ours” scores ~42% compared to LLaMA-3-8B-it’s ~40%. Finally, on Chat-Arena-Hard, “Ours” scores ~30% while LLaMA-3-8B-it scores ~22%. The legend in the top-right corner clearly distinguishes the two models by color, and the bars are grouped by dataset, with no sorting applied — the datasets are listed in the order presented. The chart visually emphasizes the consistent advantage of the “Iterative RLHF” approach across diverse academic and practical benchmarks.
